extensions.name: statement description
extensions.value: The Republic of Ireland's Health Service Executive (HSE) has approved dose dense doxorubicin and cyclophosphamide (AC 60/600, 14 days) followed by weekly paclitaxel and weekly trastuzumab (DD AC-TH) for reimbursement as a treatment option for the adjuvant treatment of patients with HER2 positive, high risk node negative or node positive breast cancer. The European Medicines Agency product information for trastuzumab notes that trastuzumab should only be used in patients with metastatic or early breast cancer whose tumors have either HER2 overexpression or HER2 gene amplification as determined by an accurate and validated assay.
